## Student ↔ Instructor alignment (100%)

Every student screen has an instructor screen that creates it, controls it, or grades it. The same data is shown in both places, so the two sides can never disagree.

## How this page works — red numbers match the screen

<table><tr><td rowspan="2">1</td><td>One master course</td></tr><tr><td>Instead of 7 duplicate &quot;NA-C&quot; test courses, there is one master course built from the WABON template, with each cohort attached to it.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="2">2</td><td></td></tr><tr><td>Versioning Changes are made in a draft version (v1.1) and go live only after Admin review, and WABoN approval when required.</td></tr><tr><td>3</td><td>Clean-up The current test courses are archived so students never see them in Explore.</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1></td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Five-step wizardToday&#x27;s wizard (Foundation, Outcomes, Investment) is for paid general courses. The CNA version adds Programrules (hours, caps, passing score), Structure, Assessments, and Review &amp; publish.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>2</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Course structureThe tree is exactly what students see in My Learning and the course player: Orientation, 9 units each with the10-lesson pattern, then Mock skills, Clinical, Exam prep. Each item shows its type, track (THEORY_ASYNC / SKILLS /CLiNICAL_SHiFT), hour type and minutes. &quot;Import WABoN template&quot; builds all of this in one click.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>3</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Hours checkAdds up the minutes of every item by hour type and confirms 35 / 33 / 40 = 108 h before the course can bepublished.</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>4</td><td rowspan=1 colspan=1>Publish checksAutomatic checks that block publishing until every WABON requirement is met (videos, rubrics, quiz pools,login-only files, skills mapping).</td></tr></table>
